cases.rationale: Three actual zebras are identifiable by their striped bodies, equine heads and legs in the dry grassland. They are zebras rather than horses or cattle. The remaining crop shows unpotted trees, brush, grass and earth. I considered each of the 75 definitions; no other defined object is visible and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The large metal fixture has the cylindrical body, top operating nut and capped side outlets of an actual fire hydrant. Its round outlet is not a parking-meter dial or clock. Surrounding grass is unpotted. I considered every one of the 75 definitions and find no other category object or unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual baseball player fills the crop, with additional blurred people in the background. The black leather item on his raised hand is a fielding glove with a broad pocket and finger structure, not a batting glove. Uniform lettering and logos add no actual objects. Each of the 75 definitions was considered; no other defined category is supported and no category ambiguity remains.

People sit around a dining table carrying plates, narrow-neck bottles, drinking tumblers and stemmed wine-glass forms. A small white open vessel near the left-center place settings has a bowl rim/body, distinct from the flatter plates. Small cutlery-like pieces at the place settings do not resolve tines, blade or spoon bowl, so fork, knife and spoon remain unclear. The partly hidden seating does not reliably distinguish individual chairs, a long bench or upholstered couch, leaving those three categories unclear. The wall picture is excluded as depicted content. I explicitly considered all 75 definitions.

Several actual people stand on a snowy slope with ski poles and narrow snow equipment. The foreground person's red/orange back area could be a small backpack or clothing; pack structure and straps are too small to establish, so backpack is unclear. The short dark equipment at that person's feet does not confidently distinguish a snowboard from overlapping skis, so snowboard is unclear. Snow, rocks, fencing and haze supply no other defined objects. All 75 definitions were individually considered.

An actual striped cat faces an entertainment cabinet. The upper-left CRT screen and casing identify a standalone television. The shelf equipment is audiovisual hardware rather than a laptop, microwave or oven. A small flat item on the right shelf may be a remote but has insufficient visible button/body detail, so remote is unclear. The cropped upholstered curved structure at lower left could be a chair part but its seating identity is incomplete, leaving chair unclear. Cabinet surfaces are not an eating table, and media cases are not identifiable bound books. Every one of the 75 definitions was considered.

An actual person in winter clothing holds two ski poles and stands on separate narrow skis visible at the bottom. This is not a snowboard, skateboard or surfboard. Gloves are ordinary winter gloves rather than a baseball mitt; the bulky collar/clothing does not identify a backpack or tie. Snow, shrubs and a building occupy the rest. I considered all 75 definitions and have no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two actual people sit at a red dining table with recognizable red individual chair backs behind them. Pizza crust and toppings identify the large foreground pizza and the portion at left. The clear plastic vessel with pink cap is a bottle; the foreground handleless drinking glass is a cup under the definition, not a stemmed wine glass. The woman holds a fork with its tined end visible. The tall wooden object is a pepper mill, and the dishes are plates rather than bowls. All 75 definitions were considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

An outdoor eating table holds blue and green open bowls, a white ramekin and another shallow colored bowl. Green plants grow from the long terracotta planter behind them, supporting potted plant. The yellow fruit is a lemon rather than an orange or banana. Small dark transparent vessels behind the left dishes do not clearly resolve drinking-tumbler versus stemmed wine-glass structure, so cup and wine glass remain unclear. The silver utensil handle protruding at right lacks a visible working end; fork, knife and spoon remain unclear. I considered each of the 75 definitions against the whole crop.

The rounded rear road vehicle at left is an actual bus with rear windows and bus body; the white vehicle at right has a cab and open cargo bed identifying a pickup truck. A very narrow partly occluded vehicle portion at the far lower-left edge could be a passenger car, but its type is not resolved, leaving car unclear. The large green highway sign and route shields are not stop signs; the curved roadside fixtures are lamps rather than identifiable traffic signals. Skyline buildings and railings add no other category. All 75 definitions were considered.

Multiple actual locomotives pull coupled freight cars along visible railway tracks, establishing train rather than truck or bus. Their painted graphics are excluded as depicted objects. Surrounding trees, hillside, rails and ballast contain no other identifiable defined objects. I explicitly considered every one of the 75 definitions; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A real person's arm and torso enter from the left, with an actual wooden chair visible behind. The cabinet contains a recognizable light-colored bound/open book; the stereo components and stacks of media cases are not a television, laptop or keyboard. On top are a bulbous narrow-neck decorative vase and a leafy plant in a visible pot. A small wall clock with a clock face hangs above the plant; stereo circular components are not clocks. The partly hidden dark surface at left could be a dining table or a side/console surface, so dining table remains unclear. Framed art and figurines do not count as the depicted categories. All 75 definitions were considered.
